title: Functions of Several Real Variables Quiz 3
description: Differentiate twice and keep track of the order.
instructions: Functions of Several Real Variables: Higher derivatives and the gradient.
Write maths answers with the keypad. Any equal form is accepted.
Every question has a trap. Slow down at the signs.

questions.question: Find $f_{xx}$ for $f=x^{2}y+3xy^{2}$.
questions.explanation: $f_x=2xy+3y^2$, so $f_{xx}=2y$. Watch out: $3y^2$ is constant in $x$.

questions.question: Find $f_{yy}$ for $f=x^{2}y+3xy^{2}$.
questions.explanation: $f_y=x^2+6xy$, so $f_{yy}=6x$. Watch out: $x^2$ is constant in $y$.

questions.question: For $f=x^{2}y+3xy^{2}$, $f_{xy}=f_{yx}$.
questions.explanation: Both equal $2x+6y$. Watch out: this is true for smooth functions, which includes polynomials.

questions.question: Find the gradient component $f_x$ of $f=x^{3}y$.
questions.explanation: Treat $y$ as constant: $3x^2y$. Watch out: do not drop the $y$.

questions.question: For $f(x,y)=x^{2}y+3xy^{2}$, the gradient at $(1,2)$ is $\nabla f=($ {{1}} , {{2}} $)$.
questions.explanation: $f_x(1,2)=16$ and $f_y(1,2)=13$. Watch out: the order is $(f_x,f_y)$.

questions.question: The gradient $\nabla f$ at a point points...
questions.explanation: The gradient is perpendicular to the level curve and points uphill. Watch out: it does not point along the level curve.

questions.question: Find $f_{xy}$ for $f=x^{3}y^{2}$. One step is wrong. Tap it.
questions.explanation: $\dfrac{\partial}{\partial y}y^2=2y$, so $f_{xy}=6x^2y$. Watch out: do not lose the power of $y$.

questions.question: Evaluate $f_{xx}(2,3)$ for $f=x^{3}y$.
questions.explanation: $f_x=3x^2y$, $f_{xx}=6xy=36$. Watch out: both variables are substituted at the end.
